findings.title: Shared Service Credential Detected (Identity Flattening)
findings.description: All MCP tools (read/write) execute under a single IAM Role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MCPSharedExecutionRole).

findings.title: Missing Input/Output Guardrails
findings.description: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails are disabled. Unsanitized tool output permits Indirect Prompt Injection attacks.

findings.title: Uncorrelated Execution Logs
findings.description: JSON-RPC tool call payloads are not mapped to UserPrincipalName in CloudTrail.
